Name: Choose Baby Gender
Author: Travoos
Description:
[b]Tested with Stardew Valley 1.1, SMAPI 0.40.1.1

[/b]This mod adds clickable male and female buttons on the baby naming screen allowing you to choose the gender of your newborn baby. It does say someone gave birth to a "girl" or "boy" before the menu comes up, but I was just too lazy to change that. Ignore that.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/k4yUtRT.png[/img]

Manifest.Name: Choose Baby Gender
Manifest.Description: Lets you choose the gender of babies as they're born
